_description: PHOTO WORLD — ray-traced chrome and glass spheres composited into a REAL photographic sky (sky.png, equirectangular environment). The chrome mirrors the photographed blue sky and clouds; the glass refracts it; a glossy reflective floor doubles the sky. Demonstrates RT realism layered onto an existing photo.

lights._comment: warm sun key, high front-right (matches a bright daytime sky)
cool sky fill from the left
rim from behind to separate spheres from sky
warm fill from high behind-camera-left so the foreground floor catches golden bounce without showing a hotspot in frame

objects._comment: === GLOSSY REFLECTIVE FLOOR — low and dark so it mirrors the sky like wet tarmac; most of the frame stays sky ===
=== CHROME SPHERE — perfect mirror, left-center, reflects the photographed sky ===
=== GLASS SPHERE — clear dielectric, right, refracts the sky behind it ===
=== SMALL CHROME ACCENT in front, ties the group ===
